column1: # Shared fork-layer rename table: NeoForge 26.2 -> 26.3 (Minecraft 26.3; NeoForge 26.3.0). Applied FIRST (nearest) on the
# 1.21.1 text, then the 26.2/26.1.2/... tables on whatever it left -- so a row here is written against the ORIGINAL 1.21
# spelling. The 26.3 class moves (com.mojang.blaze3d.* -> com.mojang.renderpearl.*, CATALOG §V101) are generated per fork
# from the staged jars (moves.generated.tsv); a rename row reaches the AUTHORS' files only, never an overlay (CATALOG §W8)
# nor a shared helper, so the helpers in shared/26.3/java are written in the 26.3 dialect by hand.
#!exhaustive  # shared library: most forks use only some of these rows
# ---- 26.3 input is SDL, not GLFW (CATALOG §V102): org.lwjgl.glfw.GLFW is off the classpath and every key / modifier /
# mouse-button number changed. The helper keeps the GLFW_* names with the 26.3 values; raw numbers need the overlay.
# InputConstants.isKeyDown(window, key) -> isKeyDown(key): SDL keeps the keyboard state globally (the window argument is gone).
# ---- PoseStack.mulPose(Quaternionf) is gone (26.3 keeps mulPose(Matrix4fc) / mulPose(Transformation)); a quaternion goes
# through rotate(Quaternionfc). 1.21's idiom is mulPose(Axis.XP.rotationDegrees(a)); a quaternion held in a variable cannot
# be told from a matrix by a row and is left to the compile error.
